props.name: cols
props.description: Visible columns, for the few cases where it matters.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial value for the uncontrolled case.

props.name: description
props.description: Persistent helper text below the field.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables interaction. Mirrors the ARIA name.

props.name: error
props.description: The validation message. Its presence drives `aria-invalid`.

props.name: form
props.description: Associates the control with a form it is not nested inside.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the field invalid independently of any error text.

props.name: label
props.description: The control's own label text, rendered above the field.

props.name: maxLength
props.description: Maximum accepted length, enforced natively. Same attribute-name reason.

props.name: minLength
props.description: Minimum accepted length, enforced natively.  Attribute-observed because Stencil's camelCase-to-kebab mapping produces `min-length`, not the native `minlength`, so `<sk-textarea minlength="2">` was silently ignored — the same class of defect `readonly` had.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder text. Never a substitute for a label.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Makes the field non-editable but still submitted and focusable.  Attribute-observed, for the same reason as `sk-input`: Stencil's camelCase-to-kebab mapping produces `read-only`, not the native `readonly`.

props.name: required
props.description: Native constraint validation still applies and is never suppressed.

props.name: rows
props.description: Visible rows. The browser's own sizing, not a pixel value.

props.name: value
props.description: The value. Uncontrolled by default: typed value only if set.

props.name: name
props.description: The name of the element, used when submitting an HTML form.

ai.summary: A multi-line text field that participates in a plain HTML form, for text too long to type on one line.
whenToUse: The value runs to several lines: a bio, a comment, release notes, an address
The consumer wants the browser to size the field by line count
It must submit through a plain `<form>` with no JavaScript state
whenNotToUse: The value is a single short string — use an Input
The value is one of a fixed set — use a Select or Radio Group
It only toggles a boolean — use a Checkbox or Switch
ai.accessibility: Renders a real native `<textarea>`, so the browser supplies constraint validation and the error bubble rather than this component reimplementing them. `label`, `description`, and `error` are wired through `<label for>` and `aria-describedby`; an error sets `aria-invalid` and renders an icon beside its text, never color alone (WCAG 1.4.1). The field resizes vertically by default, because long-form text is edited rather than typed in one line. Shares its form contract with Input.
knownLimitations: There is no `pattern` prop: a textarea has no single-line grammar for a pattern to constrain
The generated `id` for the inner control differs from React's `useId()`, so an SSR consumer must pass an explicit `id` for a separately-rendered `Label` to find it (section 4, forms contract)
